title: Tirisfal Glades Villages
note: Blizzard's order from conversation.json (trigger groups as listed, lines by conversationOrder).

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That smoke is coming from Brill! It must be the Scarlet Crusade!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then we have no time to spare. Let's move!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Are you all right, friend? I'm Garek Bandarion, captain of--

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Anya?! What are you doing?! He's Forsaken! One of us!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: No. He could have been one of us. Instead he chose to walk away.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: She is correct.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: My name is Leonid Barthalomew, knight of the Argent Dawn.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Like us, he was freed from the Scourge. And then he left the Dark Lady's side to join these paladins.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I'm surprised they didn't slay you the moment you approached them.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade and the Argent Dawn are nothing alike.  Despite my... condition, the Argent Dawn welcomed me with open arms.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: While the Scarlet zealots tarnish the legacy of the Silver Hand, we seek to uphold it.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You wear a different tabard, but it's cut from the same cloth.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Enough.  While we argue, the Scarlet Crusade continues to raze Tirisfal.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We need to act swiftly if we are to save the other villages.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I swear by the Light to aid you in your fight against the Crusade.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: To hell with your Light. You'll help us or I'll end you myself.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade is in retreat.  I must return to the Argent Dawn and report on what has transpired.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I ask that the two of you accompany me. Your knowledge of Tirisfal, and particularly of the Forsaken, exceeds my own.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Do not think for a moment that we would tell your paladins anything about the Forsaken.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: When will you realize that we are on the same side?

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Just because we share a common foe does not make us allies.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Anya, Leonid has risked his life to fight beside us.  I think he's earned the benefit of the doubt.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: My doubt is all I'm willing to offer. But if you trust him... then I'll stow my arrows for now.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I'm sure the Argent Dawn will be much obliged.  Let's not keep them waiting.

lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Oh, uh, hey!  Are you from... what's that town's name, again?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Brill. And yes, we are. Give back the lumber, and no one gets hurt.

lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Afraid I can't do that, boss.  We need it in order to finish our little zeppelin here.

lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: But... you look the other way, and maybe you'll find some gold on the ground.  You get what I mean?

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Your bribes mean nothing to us.  The people of Brill need that lumber to rebuild their homes.

lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Homes?  You're a bunch of walking corpses!  Dig a hole and jump in it!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Well, Garek?  Do we take their gold, or take their lives?

lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Ah, Captain Bandarion! Perhaps you can help me with this predicament.

lines.speaker: Olson
lines.text: The only predicament is you haven't yet arrested this murderer!

lines.speaker: Andre
lines.text: Me?! He was clearly poisoned! That makes you the prime suspect!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Enough. What happened here?

lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Someone used the Scarlet Crusade's attack to cover up a murder. Poor Saloman here was found dead, but he was nowhere near the battle.

lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: These two were the only villagers unaccounted for during the fray. Olson, the town alchemist, and Andre, the town huntsman.

lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Can you please investigate this matter for me? I have my hands full trying to get the town in order.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I'm not much of an investigator, Sedrick. But I'll do what I can.

lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Well, Captain Bandarion?  What have you found?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It was both of them.  Olson poisoned Saloman's ale to get out of paying his debt.  Andre wanted revenge for being robbed of his pelts.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: They both did the deed.  The Scarlet Crusade's attack was serendipity... and the perfect cover up.

lines.speaker: Olson
lines.text: I had no choice!  My debt would have ruined me!

lines.speaker: Andre
lines.text: That thief got what was coming to him!

lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Listen to yourselves!  You're both under arrest!  Come with me at once.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It was Andre.  This was the work of a marksman with a vendetta.

lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Hmm.  That doesn't explain the frothing around Saloman's mouth... but I suppose you're the expert.

lines.speaker: Andre
lines.text: What?! This is outrageous! I'm innocent!

lines.speaker: Olson
lines.text: Deny it all you want! The case is closed!

lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: You're under arrest, Andre. Come with me.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It was Olson. This was the work of an alchemist with access to deadly potions.

lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Hmm. That doesn't explain the wound in Saloman's back... but I suppose you're the expert.

lines.speaker: Olson
lines.text: What? No! It wasn't me!

lines.speaker: Andre
lines.text: Of course it was!  We've known it all along!

lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: You're under arrest, Olson. Come with me.

lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Oh, uh, hey!  Are you from... what's that town's name, again?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Brill. And yes, we are. Give back the lumber, and no one gets hurt.

lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Afraid I can't do that, boss.  We need it in order to finish our little zeppelin here.

lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: But... you look the other way, and maybe you'll find some gold on the ground.  You get what I mean?

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Your bribes mean nothing to us.  The people of Brill need that lumber to rebuild their homes.

lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Homes?  You're a bunch of walking corpses!  Dig a hole and jump in it!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Well, Garek?  Do we take their gold, or take their lives?

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Stay back! You profane the Light with your every action!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: He's Forsaken! Quickly, we have to help him!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The Argent Dawn sent you here alone?

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: My orders were to monitor the Scarlet Crusade and remain unseen. But I could not stand idle as they torched these villages.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Then at least you have not completely abandoned your kind.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It seems we’re too late. We should search for survivors.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The village was ransacked. Almost as if it were raided for supplies.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Fel magic. For all their faults, the Scarlet Crusade would never dabble in such vile sorcery.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: This axe is of orcish make. Blackrock clan.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Arthas and Uther drove them from these lands before the plague began. These must be holdouts.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Wolf tracks. If we follow them, they'll lead us back to the orcs.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It might be a good idea to root them out. They're not the Crusade, but they can still pose a threat.

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: For the Scarlet Crusade!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Leonid, you are a knight of the Argent Dawn, but not a paladin?

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Calling upon the Holy Light burns me from within. The undead are not meant to wield such divine power.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: At least that's something we can agree on.

lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Captain Bandarion! Deathknell is under attack!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Send word to the Undercity, we'll protect the civilians.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That seems to be all of them. We should move on.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: It pains me to see the Scarlet Crusade twist their faith into zealotry.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Justice, compassion, holiness, protection. Yet the Crusade seems to value only retribution.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: You are familiar with the tenets of the Silver Hand? Were you perhaps a paladin in life?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I... don't know. I have no memories from before my awakening. What I know of the Light, I studied in undeath.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: A waste of time, I say. The Light abhors the Forsaken, and the feeling is mutual.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: How did you come to join the Argent Dawn, and not the Forsaken?

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: When Lady Sylvanas offered me a place in the Undercity, I found that I... could not accept it.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Undeath is a malady. My hope is that one day, the Light may cure me of it and return me to the living.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You're a delusional fool. Better to accept what you are than to cling to what you used to be.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: What you call delusion, I call hope. The Light can perform miracles for those who keep faith.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Murlocs. Always in need of culling.

lines.speaker: Sally Whitemane
lines.text: Lordaeron must be purged of this undead filth!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That lunatic!  We have to stop her!

lines.speaker: Sally Whitemane
lines.text: You will not claim my life, heathens!  When I return, I will see you engulfed in flames!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade have been using these watchtowers to spy on us. It would be wise to reclaim them.

lines.speaker: Marksman
lines.text: None can hide from the Light!

lines.speaker: Magistrate Sevren
lines.text: Captain Bandarion, we are in need of your assistance.

lines.speaker: Magistrate Sevren
lines.text: Repairs have been halted because a group of goblins raided our stockpile of lumber. Can you reclaim it for us?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Of course. Leave it to us, Sevren.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: More goblins in Tirisfal. I wonder what they're up to.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We've seen enough violence today. We can get Brill the lumber it needs from elsewhere.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Revenants are a dreadful foe, even for the undead.

lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Big mistake, pal!

lines.speaker: Magistrate Sevren
lines.text: You have my gratitude. Now we can continue rebuilding Brill.

lines.speaker: Magistrate Sevren
lines.text: I take it you did not retrieve the lumber.  I suppose I will have to ask Bernd for more of it.

lines.speaker: Executor Arren
lines.text: Glad you're here, Captain Bandarion. We have a situation on our hands.

lines.speaker: Executor Arren
lines.text: The recent fighting has given rise to a death revenant in the town's graveyard.  It could pose a threat if we don't deal with it soon.

lines.speaker: Executor Arren
lines.text: With the revenant gone, we can focus on repairing the damage from the attack. Deathknell thanks you yet again.

lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Speak to me once you've completed your investigation and have determined who did the deed.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Froth around the victim's mouth. Seems like poison... but there's also an arrow wound in his back.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: An unpaid invoice for alchemical reagents. It seems Olson owed Saloman quite a bit of gold.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: This is Saloman's barn, but these pelts seem expensive and expertly prepared. Could he have stolen them from Andre?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Whatever's in this mug, it isn't merely ale. I can smell something just beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: A letter from Olson, asking Saloman to discuss his debt over a mug of ale. This would have been just before the Scarlet attack.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It seems like whoever last held this bow was in a hurry to get rid of it.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: A letter from Andre, saying he knows Saloman has been stealing his pelts and demanding he return them by today... or else.

lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: What a dreadful affair.  Thank you for helping me sort it out, Captain Bandarion.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: This seems like one of the beasts Putress mentioned. Let's bring its blood back to Apothecarium.
